description: This Java class is an implementation of the ContentService interface, providing content management functionalities such as adding, retrieving, and deleting content files, images, and content data in a system related to a merchant store. It interacts with data access objects and file managers, and includes methods for handling content files of various types, including images and static files.

classes.name: ContentServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ContentService providing methods to manage content and associated files for a merchant store, including adding, deleting, retrieving, and listing content, as well as managing content files and images.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieve a list of Content objects filtered by a specific ContentType, MerchantStore, and Language.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Delete a Content entity by its reference.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieve content by its ID and Language.

methods.name: listNameByType
methods.description: Retrieve list of ContentDescription objects filtered by ContentType list, MerchantStore, and Language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieve Content by its code for a specific MerchantStore; overloaded to include Language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Save a new Content or update an existing one.

methods.name: addContentFile
methods.description: Add a content file (image or static file) for a merchant store.

methods.name: addLogo
methods.description: Add a logo image for a merchant store.

methods.name: addOptionImage
methods.description: Add an option image for a merchant store.

methods.name: addImage
methods.description: Internal method to add an image file for a merchant store, using the contentFileManager.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Internal method to add a generic file for a merchant store, using the staticContentFileManager.

methods.name: addContentFiles
methods.description: Add multiple content files for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Remove a specific content file of a given type and name for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFiles
methods.description: Remove all content files associated with a merchant store.

methods.name: getContentFile
methods.description: Retrieve a content file of a specific type and name for a merchant store.

methods.name: getContentFiles
methods.description: List all content files of a specific type for a merchant store.

methods.name: getContentFilesNames
methods.description: Get names of content files of a specific type for a merchant store.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieve ContentDescription by store and SEO URL.
